args.v:
apiVersion: v1
        kind: Pod
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: kubectl
            image: eclipsefdn/kubectl:okd-c1
            command:
            - cat
            tty: true
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: 1
                memory: 1Gi
            volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: "/home/default/.kube"
              name: "dot-kube"
              readOnly: false
          - name: eks
            image: eclipsefdn/aws:alpine-latest
            command:
            - cat
            tty: true
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: 1
                memory: 1Gi
            volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: "/home/default/.kube"
              name: "dot-kube"
              readOnly: false
          - name: jnlp
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: 1
                memory: 1Gi
          volumes:
          - name: "dot-kube"
            emptyDir: {}

script.v:
"""
        if [ "${env.TAG_NAME}" = "" ]; then
          printf ${env.TAG_NAME}-${env.BUILD_NUMBER}
        else
          printf \$(git rev-parse --short ${env.GIT_COMMIT})-${env.BUILD_NUMBER}
        fi
      """

args.v: echo docker build --pull -t ${IMAGE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG} .  # j2gha-local: no Docker daemon in the harness
echo docker push ${IMAGE_NAME}:${IMAGE_TAG}  # j2gha-local: no registry credentials
echo ./kubernetes/helm-deploy.sh test "${IMAGE_TAG}"  # j2gha-local: no OKD cluster
echo ./kubernetes/helm-deploy.sh staging "${IMAGE_TAG}"  # j2gha-local: no OKD cluster
echo ./kubernetes/helm-deploy.sh production "${IMAGE_TAG}"  # j2gha-local: no OKD cluster

set -e
              export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1
              export KUBECONFIG="${HOME}/.kube/config"
              echo aws eks update-kubeconfig --name eks-staging-openvsx --region eu-central-1  # j2gha-local: no AWS account
              echo ./kubernetes/helm-deploy.sh aws-staging "${IMAGE_TAG}"  # j2gha-local: no EKS cluster

set -e
              export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1
              echo aws eks update-kubeconfig --name eks-production-openvsx --region eu-central-1  # j2gha-local: no AWS account
              echo ./kubernetes/helm-deploy.sh aws-production "${IMAGE_TAG}"  # j2gha-local: no EKS cluster
